Mosaic Family Wealth LLC Has $3.97 Million Stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Posted by Anthony Miller | Feb 1st, 2018 
Mosaic Family Wealth LLC raised its holdings in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2.4% in the third quarter, according to the company in its most recent filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The institutional investor owned 25,728 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after purchasing an additional 597 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for 1.5% of Mosaic Family Wealth LLC’s portfolio, making the stock its 7th largest position. Mosaic Family Wealth LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $3,965,000 as of its most recent SEC filing. 
A number of other hedge funds and other institutional investors have also modified their holdings of the business. Rosenblum Silverman Sutton S F Inc. CA acquired a new position in shares of Apple in the 3rd quarter worth approximately $422,000. Northstar Wealth Partners LLC boosted its position in Apple by 17.1% during the 3rd quarter. Northstar Wealth Partners LLC now owns 19,055 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,969,000 after purchasing an additional 2,777 shares during the period. Traynor Capital Management Inc. boosted its position in Apple by 4.0% during the 3rd quarter. Traynor Capital Management Inc. now owns 122,505 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $18,780,000 after purchasing an additional 4,692 shares during the period. Vicus Capital boosted its position in Apple by 1.1% during the 3rd quarter. Vicus Capital now owns 37,892 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $5,840,000 after purchasing an additional 419 shares during the period. Finally, Crossmark Global Holdings Inc. acquired a new position in Apple during the 3rd quarter valued at approximately $80,193,000. Hedge funds and other institutional investors own 60.26% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts: 
In other news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction on Tuesday, November 14th. The stock was sold at an average price of $172.35, for a total transaction of $2,695,726.35. Following the sale, the insider now directly owns 39,682 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $6,839,192.70. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which can be accessed through the SEC website . Also, SVP Johny Srouji sold 5,760 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction on Wednesday, November 22nd. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.40, for a total value of $1,004,544.00. Following the sale, the senior vice president now directly owns 81,560 shares in the company, valued at $14,224,064. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold 128,412 shares of company stock worth $22,115,155 over the last ninety days. 0.08% of the stock is owned by insiders. 
Shares of Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ) opened at $167.43 on Thursday. The stock has a market capitalization of $849,385.69, a price-to-earnings ratio of 18.20, a PEG ratio of 1.35 and a beta of 1.21. The company has a current ratio of 1.28, a quick ratio of 1.23 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.73. Apple Inc. has a 52-week low of $120.62 and a 52-week high of $180.10. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its earnings results on Thursday, November 2nd. The iPhone maker reported $2.07 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $1.87 by $0.20. The company had revenue of $52.58 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $50.71 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 36.29% and a net margin of 21.09%. Apple’s revenue for the quarter was up 12.2% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same period in the previous year, the firm earned $1.50 earnings per share. research analysts anticipate that Apple Inc. will post 11.13 EPS for the current fiscal year. 
AAPL has been the subject of a number of analyst reports. Mizuho set a $160.00 price objective on Apple and gave the company a “hold” rating in a research report on Wednesday, October 18th. Vetr lowered Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and set a $178.34 price objective for the company. in a research report on Friday, December 1st. UBS Group set a $190.00 price objective on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research report on Friday, January 5th. Needham & Company LLC boosted their price objective on Apple from $175.00 to $200.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research report on Friday, November 3rd. Finally, Morgan Stanley restated a “buy” rating and set a $205.00 price objective (up previously from $200.00) on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, January 23rd. Two investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twelve have assigned a hold rating, thirty-seven have given a buy rating and two have assigned a strong buy rating to the company. The company currently has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $201.25.
